title: AI Engineer building production LLM systems

description.primary: I am an AI Engineer — currently Analyst, AI & Agent Systems at Future Standard — where I design agentic memory architectures that let AI agents retain and recall operational context across multi-step workflows, and build agent systems for operations and process intelligence. I own delivery end-to-end: agent orchestration (LangGraph/LiteLLM), backend APIs, evaluation pipelines, and production deployment.
description.secondary: Previously at OnFinance AI, I built ComplianceOS end-to-end (DB → backend → cloud → LLM pipelines), saving 1,500+ hours/year on BFSI compliance, with AI features contributing to $800K+ ARR and LangGraph + LiteLLM workflows processing 1B+ tokens/month. Before that, as an SDE Intern at RingCentral, I led an Angular 1.x → React migration that made load times 3x faster. My focus is production RAG, agentic workflows, and AI agents for complex domains.
